notes.title: WIP - Animation & Stamina Update
notes.notes:
WIP Update - The Scourge | Tai Ương

The hungry ghost in our Demo got lots of feedback so we decided to remake the animation. Also, stamina now has been added into ‘The Scourge’. Our team now (may) become running simulation instead of walking simulation.
